def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts={}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row: counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
    bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp)
        c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        perimeter={(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                   if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
        if set(comp)!=perimeter: continue
        inside={(y,x) for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)}
        if any(grid[y][x]!=bg for y,x in inside): continue
        fill=2 if (r1-r0-1)%2==0 else 7
        for y,x in inside: out[y][x]=fill
    return out

def parse_grid_section(text,label):
    start=text.index(label)+len(label)
    section=text[start:]
    section=section.split('\n',1)[1]
    rows=[]
    for line in section.splitlines():
        if not line.strip() or not re.match(r'^\d',line.strip()): break
        rows.append(list(map(int,line.split())))
    return rows
